title: Great food and history

title: Amazing tour guide!

title: 10/10 experience! Thanks Alvaro!!
text: Alvaro was the best tour guide!! Very friendly, and extremely knowledgeable on the history and traditions of Seville. We are here on a family trip visiting Spain from the U.S, and Alvaro took us to the best spots for drinks and tapas, and shared his insight and love for the beautiful city of Seville. 10/10 experience !!
author: B8852IJrachelp

title: A full evening of entertainment and a cultural food experience
text: This was a jam packed experience and Ismael was a knowledgeable and gracious host. It began with a flamenco show followed by tapas and drinks. Ismael hand picked the foods and drinks that best showcased Spanish culture while weaving in personal stories that brought it all to life. The food was plentiful and delicious as were the drinks. We highly recommend this tour
author: Debra K

title: This was a full cultural and gastronomical experience
text: Ismael was a wonderful guide as we began with a lively flamenco show. Immediately after we visited 3 places for tapas and drinks handpicked by him to showcase the Spanish and Sevilla way of life and culture. Ismael wove in stories of his own experiences with these foods as well.
author: Debra_K

title: A lovely evening to experience Seville. ❤️💛❤️💛
text: Our guide, Helena, created a very special evening for us. She took us to three wonderful establishments.  Her knowledge and passion for food and flamenco were amazing. She really brought the culture of Spain to life. We loved our experience.
